question: Slate colors are in (round-011 b, now live in theme.css). Beyond color, what character should the lab have? Same Compare page and colors in all three; radius, depth, type and spacing differ. Logo comes after this.

variants.label: Crisp tool
variants.changes: Like an IDE: small radius (0.25rem), tight spacing, flat surfaces with no shadows, mono uppercase labels, one-line frame header, slim answer bar.

variants.label: Soft layers
variants.changes: Like a calm app: large radius (0.875rem), the frame a raised card with a shadow on a muted canvas, roomier padding, bigger label, pill badges, a floating answer bar.

variants.label: Editorial
variants.changes: Like a print page: medium radius (0.5rem), no frame box, a strong rule above each section, a large label, small uppercase meta and table heads, generous whitespace.
